responseText:
The most dangerous. Here's the thing, I'm not proud of every choice I've ever made. And a few times? A few times since I've come to Verra I've felt a little sick - worse than sick - when I was involved in some unfortunate decisions. Best not to ask.

Thing is though, those Rune-carved Gemstones? They make me feel that same kind of sick - but if I were to tell Naho or Sanvi that, what would they think? You know it, they'd think it was a ruse to get myself some loot.
name: ANV_FTUE_BF_Taelo_7_Response
